text: 6. MESSAGE FUNCTION The Trade Net Declaration message permits the transfer of data from the Declarant to SC and CA (if applicable) for the purpose of meeting legislative and/or operational requirements in respect of the declaration of goods for import, export or transit. Transfer conditions are: Code Declaration Type Transfer Conditions TTI Transhipment with Inter-gateway To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as: movement a) movement of goods between FTZ for transhipment b) storage of goods at approved Class II Yard pending transshipment TTF Transhipment within same FTZ To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as: a) internal delivery of goods within the same FTZ IGM Inter-gateway movement To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as: a) movement of goods between FTZ for bulk breaking or storage b) bonded Truck Scheme (for courier parcel transhipment) REM Removal To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as: a) movement of goods between licensed premises such as Licensed Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded Warehouse b) movement of goods under TIS BRE Blanket Removal To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as: a) movement of goods between licensed premises such as Licensed
